artifacts.summary: Confirms the C14 pin gap is real for the three witness-family decidability rows, verifies via direct #print axioms probe that all three declarations are exactly pcq, and specifies the exact two-heredoc append (text, order, insertion point) needed to close it; also confirms task 724's corollary declaration has not landed, so only a naming comment is folded in, not a fourth pin.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's C14 check compares two heredocs (C14_BASELINE, C14LEAN) by exact string equality in matching order; a declaration must be appended to BOTH, in the same relative position, or the check hard-fails rather than silently updating. Downstream consumers (C21, C36) parse these heredocs dynamically from the script's own source text, so baseline growth does not require updating any hardcoded count -- except one purely descriptive, non-enforced comment near C21 that can drift stale.

docs/theorem-index.md's pinned:C14 cell is a claim about scripts/check-module-invariants.sh actually running a #print axioms check for that declaration -- grepping the declaration name against the script is the cheap way to catch a false pinned: claim (a name appearing only in an unrelated allowlist, e.g. C23's shadow-pair allowlist, does not count as pinned).
